feature: Bounded HID Report Map and Report Reference reads with validated descriptor routes

firmware.installation_status: No automatic installer. Verify the actual device partition table and recovery backup before installation.

findings: Characteristic reads use GATT_READ_BY_HANDLE; the SDK assembles consecutive Read Blob responses
gatt_process_read_rsp clips at GATT_MAX_ATTR_LEN and can report success at that limit
The inspected limit is 517 bytes; this BLE path accepts 1..=512 and statically requires a larger public SDK limit
GATT_AUTH_REQ_NONE skips the client security request; ATT errors are returned to the operation callback

verified: Completed values are copied into a fixed single-read slot and require matching operation, interface, connection and handle
Maps accept 1..=512 bytes; references require exactly two bytes
Duplicate or mismatched current-connection completions and failed/invalid-length responses latch failure
Stale connections cannot complete a pending read
Disconnect, service changes and timeout discard already-completed unconsumed reads and preserve cleanup handles
Descriptor validation covers ordering, range, required UUIDs, duplicate rejection and the 16-entry boundary
A host read sequence feeds a parsed HID map and its reference into validated routes and decodes a PageDown press
Bluetooth firmware compiles, links and passes image packaging validation
limits: No physical radio, long-read interoperability, connection, timing, SDK-cache ownership or teardown test
No pairing, bond storage, CCCD writes, notification registration, page-turn dispatch or reconnect
Peers requiring authenticated reads are not yet supported by this diagnostic
Descriptor ownership relies on the SDK characteristic-specific query plus local count/order/range checks
The 512-byte BLE map bound is stricter than the portable parser limit of 4096 bytes
SDK internal allocations and synchronous call/destructor behavior remain outside the portable buffer bounds
Normal non-Bluetooth and grayscale builds, clean reproducibility, native GUI and independent tailnet fixture not rerun
